addressGoes: Console → Phone Numbers → Active numbers → your number → A message comes in
notes: **A picture with no words** is not passed on: the adapter takes a message with an empty body for a delivery report.

why.maxTextLength: Twilio refuses a body of more than 1,600 characters (error 21617), and the adapter cuts a longer one short before sending it and says nothing (TWILIO_MESSAGE_LIMIT). 1,500 is within that, with room.
why.addressGoes: A number's webhook is set on the number's own page in the Twilio Console, as a webhook by HTTP POST. Twilio's API can set it too (the number's SmsUrl), so a command could: none does yet.
why.plainText: A text message shows text as it is typed. The adapter sends Markdown as its source, so a person would read **Plan A** and [link](url).
why.notes: chunk-V6VOK4O2.js: an inbound message with an empty Body and SmsStatus=received is handled as a status callback.
